name: Gregory Fleischer
biography: has over ten years experience in application development and software security. As an independent security researcher, he has worked with The Tor Project to identify weaknesses in Tor application components such as Torbutton, Vidalia and Privoxy. He has reported vulnerabilities in widely used client-side technologies including Mozilla Firefox, Sun Java and Adobe Flash. Gregory is currently employed as application security engineer with an online brokerage firm.
